beats.headline: Behind the yak poster
beats.text: Behind the jukebox at Chicken and Waffles and Upgrades is the room of top-shelf upgrades, and the upgrade imp, Hickster, lies dead on the counter with his eyes burned out, killed by Akuma. A note in black crayon on a kiddie menu calls Carl a moron for not coming alone. Behind a poster of a hairy yak in body armour is a secret door, and attached to the door is a hidden disintegration trap. Carl hops the counter, rips the poster off, deactivates and loots the trap module, scans for more, and opens the door on Akuma.

beats.headline: Keyed to Tigrans
beats.text: While Donut talks the twin Tigrans of One Fine Pig into staring at her, with relationship advice for their pig, Carl takes about five seconds to lay a hidden trap on each side of their truck, as close to its shield as he dares. Both are disintegration traps, like the one he looted from the war mage's door. They activate silently and target a single individual, and to be safe he programs both to go off only when stepped on by a Tigran. Even if one is carrying Penelope, she should be safe.

beats.headline: A pair of notifications
beats.text: At the pit stop, before Carl can announce the crew's new track, the notifications come in a pair. Your trap has activated: he has dissolved a Tigran. Another trap has activated, and he has dissolved another. Team One Fine Pig is eliminated on the expiration of both racers, and five teams remain. Carl holds his breath, waiting for a notification about Penelope the pig. There is none.
